name: Crack-free Isosurface Extraction from AMR Data
aliases: Crack-free isosurface extraction from AMR data
Dual grid isosurface extraction with ghost cells
Parallel extraction of crack-free isosurfaces from AMR data
Stitch Cell Generation for AMR Isosurfaces
definition: A method to extract watertight, crack-free isosurfaces from block-structured Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) data in a distributed-memory parallel environment. It solves the problem of T-junctions (cracks) that arise when standard Marching Cubes is applied to hierarchical data, and overcomes the memory and serial processing limitations of previous dual-grid approaches by using ghost cells.
